info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Warehouse Inventory Locations-v4-spec
info.description: The Warehouse Inventory Locations API provides a comprehensive overview of all inventory locations within a warehouse. It enables users to query and retrieve detailed information about each location, facilitating efficient inventory management and optimization. This API is typically utilized by logistics managers, supply chain analysts, and inventory control systems to monitor warehouse layouts and inventory distributions. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their operational effectiveness and decision-making processes.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of inventory locations.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current inventory locations, enabling effective stock management and optimization of supply chain logistics.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving inventory location information. This body must include the necessary criteria to fetch relevant location details from the inventory system.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the inventory location data.

ListWarehouseInventoryLocationsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to inventory location. It is a simple string type value.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the operation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the inventory operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListWarehouseInventoryLocationsResponse_.description: Response schema for the successful retrieval of inventory location operations.

createdBy.description: The user who created the inventory operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the inventory operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the inventory operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. This value can help in assessing the performance of the API endpoint.
